response.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_running_time, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_replacement_to_rental_ratio FROM film WHERE length >= 112;

assumptions.assumption: A long film is one with length of at least 112 minutes, so films of exactly 112 minutes are included. Films with NULL length are excluded by the filter, and the rental_rate divisor is never zero in the data (minimum 0.99).

alternatives.interpretation: A long film is strictly longer than 112 minutes, so films of exactly 112 minutes are excluded.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_running_time, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_replacement_to_rental_ratio FROM film WHERE length > 112;

alternatives.interpretation: A long film is strictly longer than 112 minutes, so films of exactly 112 minutes are excluded.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_running_time, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_replacement_to_rental_ratio FROM film WHERE length > 112;
